shared_elements: low-relief carving into a rock/stone surface
curvilinear figural motifs cut into stone
justification: Both surfaces bear figural relief cut into stone, but the content is unrelated: A shows long processional registers of naturalistically proportioned standing human figures in profile with staffs, garments, animals being led, and framing ornamental bands, while B shows a few isolated schematic curvilinear motifs (a large curved crescent-like form and a spiral) scattered on an irregular boulder face with no registers, no human figures and no processional order. The only correspondence is the generic fact of relief carving on rock, which any tradition could produce independently.
